arc.fallback: Jack the Ripper and Zeppeli the Strange

description.fallback: The papers report the continuous murder performed by the notorious Jack the Ripper; nothing is known of his identity. During this time, late one night, a couple is seen walking down an empty street in London. The woman says she has read in the news that the killer known as Jack the Ripper has been murdering women recently, and she is afraid of running into him.
